description: Impact of conditioning on prior answers for multi-question coherence
finding: Sequential conditioning raises Spearman correlation on dependent question pairs from 0.28 to 0.65 (human panels: 0.71) and cuts contradictions from 10.4% to 1.8% — a +13.4 pp consistency improvement that recovers most of the gap to human coherence. Marginal distributions (JS) are unaffected.
